name: None default allocates per call
diff:
--- a/example/module.py
+++ b/example/module.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+def append_item(item, items=None):
+    if items is None:
+        items = []
+    items.append(item)
+    return items

name: Specific exception preserves interrupts

--- a/example/module.py
+++ b/example/module.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@

+    try:
+        return int(value)

name: Safe YAML loader
diff:
